tools.name: search_mcp_servers
tools.description: Search 59+ MCP servers by keyword, category, or capability. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402 micropayment on Base mainnet. No API key required.

params.name: query
params.description: Search query — e.g. "vector database", "send email", "browser automation"

params.name: category
params.description: Filter by category: communication | data | web | code | ai | payments | identity | productivity | infrastructure | media

tools.name: get_server_details
tools.description: Get full metadata for a specific MCP server by ID. Free — no payment required. Returns endpoint, install command, auth type, tags, use cases, and health status.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all server categories with descriptions. Free.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Get AgentNDX registry statistics: total servers, protocol counts, verified count. Free.
